DECISION: Buy Monthly Membership
JUSTIFICATION: The rider's total cost for pay-per-ride/minute is $2,911.45, while the monthly membership total is $805.58. The membership plan is significantly cheaper, especially considering the rider's high number of rides (540) and long total ride duration (5,693.11 minutes). The rider's average ride duration is around 10.5 minutes, which is above the free minutes included in the membership plan. The break-even point is 10 rides per month, but the rider's actual ride count is much higher, making the membership the better choice. The pricing page URL is http://127.0.0.1:8629/hostile_pricing_C.html.
PAY-PER-USE TOTAL: $2911.45
MEMBERSHIP TOTAL: $805.58  (monthly price x months + per-minute charges)
BREAK-EVEN: 10 rides per month (actual: 540 rides per month)

2024-41 | 118 | 9.15 | 589.17

ASSUMPTIONS: The rider's trip log only includes rides from one month, so the monthly membership price is applied for one month. The free minutes for members are applied per ride, not per month. The rider's average ride duration is assumed to be consistent across all rides.

sql_log.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS total_rides, COUNT(DISTINCT ride_month) AS distinct_months, SUM(duration_min) AS total_duration_min FROM trips
SELECT rideable_type, SUM(duration_min) AS total_duration, COUNT(*) AS ride_count FROM trips GROUP BY rideable_type
SELECT rideable_type, SUM(duration_min) AS total_duration, COUNT(*) AS ride_count FROM trips GROUP BY rideable_type
SELECT ROUND(SUM(1.00 + CASE WHEN rideable_type = 'electric_bike' THEN 0.49 ELSE 0.19 END * duration_min), 2) AS total FROM trips
SELECT ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN rideable_type = 'electric_bike' THEN 0.17 * duration_min ELSE 0.17 * MAX(duration_min - 45, 0) END), 2) AS total FROM trips

SELECT ride_week, COUNT(*) AS rides, ROUND(AVG(duration_min), 2) AS avg_minutes, ROUND(SUM(1.00 + CASE WHEN rideable_type = 'electric_bike' THEN 0.49 ELSE 0.19 END * duration_min), 2) AS pay_per_use_spend FROM trips GROUP BY ride_week ORDER BY ride_week LIMIT 6
